purpose: Estimate shared-dictionary trade-offs in receiver resources, capacity, quality and detectability.
prior_results_policy: Earlier runs are development evidence; never add them to the new test.

source_groups.unit: source/event near-duplicate component; derivatives, models, keys and payloads are dependent
source_groups.sampling_frame: One fixed official English Wikipedia content export; exact snapshot and attribution/license manifest to be materialized. Exclude redirects, lists, disambiguation pages and source/event duplicates before splitting. One source per component; header plus lead and up to three complete sentences, at most 180 words.
source_groups.selection: Freeze content-only eligibility, duplicate clustering and corpus coverage before model generation; choose sources by stable SHA-256 order with recorded salt. Do not select on capacity, detector score or output quality.
source_groups.strata: 10 declared topic strata x 5 declared genres x 2 target lengths = 100 cells. Each cell: 1 development, 4 detector_train, 1 detector_validation, 10 test. Topic/genre definitions not yet materialized; one genre per source, no synthetic multiplication of groups.

claude_extension.rule: Freeze exact available model IDs, API version, provider request fields and spending cap after live preflight. Prefer direct Anthropic; OpenRouter needs a separately labeled, fixed provider route. Same full group panel; additions after test inspection are separately declared replications.
claude_extension.live_calls_scope: Three development smoke requests executed on the user's PC; no Claude large-panel attempts executed.
claude_extension.next_step: Materialize the common source/prompt/split manifest, then execute the development subset with a separately frozen output cap and spending budget. Smoke prompts remain outside train/validation/test.

length.assignment: 50/50 in every split, shared across models
length.primary: All planned attempts by requested length, with achieved word/token counts, stop reason, truncation and refusal. Requested length is not equal achieved length.
length.generation_cap: Set on development and freeze; no output-dependent cap changes.
length.secondary: Deterministic prefix ending at the last complete sentence at or below the assigned word ceiling, using a fixed segmenter. Retain shorter texts; no complete sentence is a reported category. Common-length windows across models are conditional sensitivity analyses with coverage.

codec.normalized_payload_rule: 8*floor(rho*max(C-H,0)/8); below 8 is insufficient capacity, never an empty-message success. For method contrasts, use equal useful payload in the intersection of eligible capacities and report coverage.
codec.primary_key: One public experimental 32-byte fixture per source group, domain separated from payload/order seeds; paired selectors use identical key and payload.
codec.baseline: Old fixed_quality on identical covers and useful payload lengths; separately count serialized codebook, external length, public dictionary and model assets. Modern runnable matched baseline required before SOTA claims.

aes_bundle.order: Manifest order, non-overlapping groups, same membership across models; no capacity selection
aes_bundle.missing_member_policy: Unavailable container retained in planned denominator; no replacement subset.
aes_bundle.inference_unit: Four-source bundle, not its four texts
aes_bundle.scope: Secondary; precision is not n=1000 protected containers. A reliability claim at that scale needs a separate 4000-test-text/model phase.

primary_endpoints: Full recovery of 8 useful bits with plain_length16 over all planned test attempts, per model and requested length.
Paired full-text NLL difference quality minus canonical on jointly deliverable 8-bit covers, using frozen independent scorer; report eligibility and conditional scope.
analysis.independent_scorer: Qwen2.5-1.5B base from previous scorer; restore/freeze exact checkpoint, window, dtype and runtime hashes. Family overlap with Qwen generator remains a limitation.
analysis.selection_scorer: Frozen GPT-2; its own PPL is a secondary non-independent measure.
analysis.quality_ratio: exp(mean(NLL_quality-NLL_canonical)); same tokenizer/scorer only. Also compare quality to original and fixed_quality.
analysis.ci: 95% paired stratified source-group bootstrap, 10000 resamples with fixed seed; same sampled clusters across model/method comparisons. AES uses bundle clusters. Report topic-dependence sensitivity.

binomial_precision.scope: Wilson planning illustration at p=0.5 for independent Bernoulli outcomes, not guaranteed power/precision for quality, AUC or residual clusters.

analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction over the three local-model primary quality contrasts. Other loads, length subgroups, keys and added models are declared secondary, with hypothesis families set before test.
analysis.failures: Separate capacity failure, refusal, token cap, transport error, unknown interrupted attempt and decoding failure. Preserve all; no silent retries/replacement.

steganalysis.split: 400 train / 100 validation / 1000 test source groups; every derivative, sentence, key and model of one source stays together
steganalysis.fit: Vocabulary and transforms train only; thresholds/hyperparameters validation only; freeze before opening test
steganalysis.pairing: Stego and control cover use the same deliverable groups for each method/load; failed delivery remains in the separate all-attempt analysis.

human_evaluation.plan: Blind paired ratings on a preselected stratified 150-group subset (50 per model, balanced requested lengths), at least three independent ratings per comparison; randomize order, retain source and rater clustering and missing ratings

requirements: Actual waited exit status per child process
Append-only attempt record before each request
Hash raw input/output and complete model/config identity
Verified remote checkpoint after each batch; pause if persistence fails
No automatic retry of unknown paid outcome
One process owns run lock; completed attempts never rerun
Single locked test opening after code, transformations, detectors and analysis are fixed
execution.resource_plan: Measure wall time, peak RAM, tokens and total-cost extrapolation using development only. GPU preferred for thousands of full-text scoring passes; CPU feasibility unconfirmed. No compute purchased.
launch_gate: Recover and verify the previous complete pilot archive if a backup exists; otherwise document the evidence loss and reconstruct/validate required code and assets under a new run ID, without relabeling it as the old result.
Materialize source snapshot, exact prompts and audited split manifest
Implement/test scalable runner; this design is not accepted by old pilot runner
Freeze dictionary, algorithms, scorer and runtime identities
Verify statistics with known synthetic cases

For Claude, preserve the successful three-model inference smoke; freeze the large-panel settings and budget and measure sustained throughput on development. Account balance and quota remain unverified.
Commit final frozen protocol before test generation

blockers: Original completed shared-dictionary pilot archive remains absent from checked sources; exact old final results cannot be reconstructed from prose.
Common source manifest and scalable execution code are not materialized/validated.
Dictionary/algorithm/scorer identities and the large-panel Claude token cap, cost budget and throughput remain to be fixed.
